data: Synthetic screenshots rendered by the script; labels by construction. Not real-world data.
dev_usage: The dev split (seed 1001) was run twice: once to find errors, once after fixing them (amount extractor dropped ISO codes; OCR O/0 confusion in references; explanation for the rupee sign read as a digit). No held-out output had been seen.

held_out.recipient_names: list B, disjoint from dev list A
held_out.run_policy: Run once. The script refuses to overwrite an existing test result or to run if the config hash changes. Results are reported as observed, failures included; no fix made after the run may be described as evaluated on this split.

primary_metric: review-needed detection on legible images: precision, recall, F1, FPR, FNR with positive = conflicts with user expectation or placeholder recipient; predicted positive = decision verify_first or high_risk
secondary_metrics: severe-warning rate on degraded vs legible images
mismatch findings raised on degraded images
no_acceptance_threshold: No pass/fail threshold is pre-registered; this is a measurement, not a gate.
